title: The Life of a Stickman 💔 (Try Not to Cry) #Shorts
description:
He was born from a single pencil stroke. He found love, drew a glowing heart, but couldn't stop the eraser of time from taking her. Broken and growing old in the rain, he found one last piece of pencil lead... and drew a blooming shelter for a child who would live after him.

Lines may fade, but love never rubs away. 🌸💔

Watch the full animated short film on our channel: What If Studio
